content.value_statement: Apps often need clean content from one known URL. This skill guides a focused Firecrawl /scrape integration for page extraction.
actual_capabilities: Guides when to use Firecrawl /scrape for one known URL.
Recommends markdown as the default output for page content.
Explains when to request HTML, links, screenshots, metadata, or structured output.
Advises using onlyMainContent for article-like pages with navigation noise.
Routes missing URLs to search and interactive pages to interaction guidance.
Links source documentation for Node, Python, Rust, Java, Elixir, and REST.
limitations: It does not discover URLs or crawl entire sites.
It does not handle click, typing, or multi-step browser workflows.
It requires a Firecrawl API key or configured self-hosted endpoint.
It provides integration guidance, not a complete application by itself.

use_cases.title: Add Known-URL Extraction
use_cases.description: Add a narrow scrape feature when users already provide a page URL.

use_cases.title: Feed Retrieval Pipelines
use_cases.description: Collect markdown and metadata from approved pages for indexing or enrichment.

use_cases.title: Monitor Page Changes
use_cases.description: Extract pricing, changelog, or documentation pages for page-level checks.

prompt_templates.title: Add Basic Scrape
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a known URL
prompt_templates.prompt: Use firecrawl-build-scrape to add a Firecrawl /scrape integration for one known URL. Return markdown and keep the feature small.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Output Formats
prompt_templates.scenario: Select formats for a product requirement
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this scraping requirement and choose Firecrawl output formats. Explain when markdown, HTML, links, screenshots, or metadata are needed.

prompt_templates.title: Design Extraction Contract
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a single-page extraction contract for Firecrawl /scrape. Include input URL handling, output fields, errors, and downstream consumer needs.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Production Integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a production Firecrawl /scrape integration for known URLs. Cover API key handling, rendering options, retries, storage, observability, and escalation rules.

output_examples.input: A developer needs article text from one documentation URL.
output_examples.output: The assistant recommends Firecrawl /scrape with markdown output and onlyMainContent when navigation noise affects the result.

output_examples.input: A team needs screenshots and metadata from a product page.
output_examples.output: The assistant selects richer formats only for the required fields and keeps the integration scoped to one URL.

output_examples.input: A request involves a page that requires clicks before content appears.
output_examples.output: The assistant explains that /scrape is not enough and routes the task to interaction guidance.

best_practices: Start with markdown output and add richer formats only when consumers need them.
Use onlyMainContent when page chrome or navigation adds noise.
Keep each integration focused on one feature, one URL, and one extraction contract.
anti_patterns: Using /scrape when the application does not have a URL yet.
Requesting screenshots, HTML, and links when markdown is enough.
Using this guidance for workflows that require clicks, forms, or navigation steps.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it when an app has one URL and needs content or metadata from that page.

faq.question: Does it support full-site crawling?
faq.answer: No. Use a broader Firecrawl crawl pattern when the job spans many pages.

faq.question: What output should I request first?
faq.answer: Request markdown first unless the feature clearly needs another format.

faq.question: Can it handle pages that require clicks?
faq.answer: No. Use interaction guidance when content requires clicks, typing, or multi-step navigation.

faq.question: Does it need credentials?
faq.answer: Hosted Firecrawl requests require FIRECRAWL_API_KEY. Self-hosted deployments can also set FIRECRAWL_API_URL.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
